/**
 * Shared configuration and utilities for the Sterile STOCK app.
 */

const APP_CONFIG = {
  title: 'ระบบคลังเครื่องมือ และวัสดุปราศจากเชื้อ ตึกพิเศษปาริฉัตร (Sterile STOCK)',
  shortTitle: 'Sterile STOCK',
  hospitalName: 'ตึกพิเศษปาริฉัตร',
  spreadsheetId: '1U10pMDTQdlJieOO_kl9PAgfOAKRnjNUiZjrhmTtPLUU',
  timeZone: 'Asia/Bangkok'
};

const SHEET_NAMES = {
  DATA: 'Data',
  STOCK: 'Stock',
  RECEIVE: 'ReceiveLogs',
  DISPATCH: 'DispatchLogs',
  SETTINGS: 'Settings'
};

const SHEET_HEADERS = {
  DATA: ['ItemMasterID', 'ชื่อรายการ', 'ประเภท', 'หน่วยนับ', 'หมายเหตุ'],
  STOCK: ['ItemCode', 'ชื่อรายการ', 'วันที่รับเข้า', 'วันที่นึ่ง', 'วันที่หมดอายุ', 'จำนวนคงเหลือ', 'สถานะ', 'LastUpdate'],
  RECEIVE: ['ReceiveID', 'ItemCode', 'วันที่รับเข้า', 'ชื่อรายการ', 'วันที่นึ่ง', 'วันที่หมดอายุ', 'จำนวนรับ', 'Printed', 'CreatedBy', 'Timestamp'],
  DISPATCH: ['DispatchID', 'ItemCode', 'ชื่อรายการ', 'วันที่จ่ายออก', 'จำนวนจ่ายออก', 'ประเภทการจ่าย', 'หมายเหตุ', 'CreatedBy', 'Timestamp'],
  SETTINGS: ['Key', 'Value', 'Note']
};

const STATUS_LABELS = {
  NORMAL: 'ปกติ',
  EXPIRING_3: 'ใกล้หมดอายุ 3 วัน',
  EXPIRING_2: 'ใกล้หมดอายุ 2 วัน',
  EXPIRING_1: 'ใกล้หมดอายุ 1 วัน',
  EXPIRED_TODAY: 'หมดอายุวันนี้',
  EXPIRED: 'หมดอายุแล้ว',
  EMPTY: 'หมด'
};

const APP_ICON_DATA_URL =
  'data:image/png;base64,...';

/**
 * Returns the app configuration enriched with URLs used by the frontend.
 * @returns {Object}
 */
function getAppConfig_() {
  const baseUrl = getWebAppUrl_();
  return {
    ...APP_CONFIG,
    baseUrl,
    manifestUrl: getAssetUrl_('manifest'),
    serviceWorkerUrl: getAssetUrl_('sw'),
    iconDataUrl: APP_ICON_DATA_URL
  };
}

/**
 * Returns the deployment URL when available.
 * @returns {string}
 */
function getWebAppUrl_() {
  try {
    return ScriptApp.getService().getUrl() || '';
  } catch (error) {
    return '';
  }
}

/**
 * Builds the asset URL used by the shell and PWA endpoints.
 * @param {string} asset
 * @returns {string}
 */
function getAssetUrl_(asset) {
  const baseUrl = getWebAppUrl_();
  if (!baseUrl) {
    return '';
  }
  return `${baseUrl}?asset=${encodeURIComponent(asset)}`;
}

/**
 * Opens the configured spreadsheet and falls back safely when needed.
 * @returns {GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet}
 */
function getSpreadsheet_() {
  const propertyId = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
  const spreadsheetId = (propertyId || APP_CONFIG.spreadsheetId || '').trim();
  if (spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(spreadsheetId);
  }
  const activeSpreadsheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!activeSpreadsheet) {
    throw new Error('ไม่พบ Spreadsheet ที่เชื่อมต่อกับระบบ');
  }
  return activeSpreadsheet;
}

/**
 * Ensures every required sheet exists with the correct header row.
 * @returns {void}
 */
function ensureSchema_() {
  const spreadsheet = getSpreadsheet_();
  Object.entries(SHEET_HEADERS).forEach(([key, headers]) => {
    const sheetName = SHEET_NAMES[key];
    let sheet = spreadsheet.getSheetByName(sheetName);
    if (!sheet) {
      sheet = spreadsheet.insertSheet(sheetName);
    }
    const currentHeaders = sheet.getLastRow() > 0 ? sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).getValues()[0] : [];
    const shouldWriteHeaders = currentHeaders.length < headers.length || headers.some((header, index) => currentHeaders[index] !== header);
    if (shouldWriteHeaders) {
      sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
      sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    }
  });
  seedSettingsIfNeeded_();
}

/**
 * Seeds Settings with sensible defaults.
 * @returns {void}
 */
function seedSettingsIfNeeded_() {
  const sheet = getSheet_(SHEET_NAMES.SETTINGS);
  if (sheet.getLastRow() > 1) {
    return;
  }
  const defaults = [
    ['appTitle', APP_CONFIG.title, 'ชื่อระบบ'],
    ['hospitalName', APP_CONFIG.hospitalName, 'ชื่อหน่วยงาน'],
    ['timeZone', APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'เขตเวลา'],
    ['createdBy', '', 'ผู้ใช้งานเริ่มต้น']
  ];
  sheet.getRange(2, 1, defaults.length, defaults[0].length).setValues(defaults);
}

/**
 * Returns a sheet by name and creates it if necessary.
 * BUGFIX: the previous implementation used
 * `Object.values(SHEET_HEADERS).find(() => true)`, which always resolves to
 * the FIRST entry in SHEET_HEADERS (the "Data" headers) regardless of which
 * sheet was actually requested. If this path ever ran for "Stock" (e.g. the
 * tab was renamed/deleted by hand), it silently created a "Stock" sheet with
 * the wrong 5-column header row instead of the correct 8-column Stock
 * header, which breaks every column index lookup downstream
 * (loadStockRowsRaw_, dispatchStock_, receiveStock_, etc.) and can look like
 * "dispatch saves the log but never updates Stock".
 * @param {string} sheetName
 * @returns {GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet}
 */
function getSheet_(sheetName) {
  const spreadsheet = getSpreadsheet_();
  let sheet = spreadsheet.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sheet) {
    sheet = spreadsheet.insertSheet(sheetName);
    const headers = getHeadersForSheetName_(sheetName);
    if (headers) {
      sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
      sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    }
  }
  return sheet;
}

/**
 * Resolves the correct header row for a given sheet name by reversing the
 * SHEET_NAMES map, instead of blindly returning the first header set.
 * @param {string} sheetName
 * @returns {Array<string>|null}
 */
function getHeadersForSheetName_(sheetName) {
  const key = Object.keys(SHEET_NAMES).find((k) => SHEET_NAMES[k] === sheetName);
  return key ? SHEET_HEADERS[key] : null;
}

/**
 * Returns the settings sheet as a key-value map.
 * @returns {Object<string, string>}
 */
function getSettingsMap_() {
  ensureSchema_();
  return withCachedJson_(CACHE_SCOPES.SETTINGS, { scope: 'settings' }, () => {
    const sheet = getSheet_(SHEET_NAMES.SETTINGS);
    const values = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    const settings = {
      appTitle: APP_CONFIG.title,
      hospitalName: APP_CONFIG.hospitalName,
      timeZone: APP_CONFIG.timeZone,
      createdBy: ''
    };
    values.slice(1).forEach((row) => {
      const key = safeText_(row[0]);
      if (key) {
        settings[key] = row[1] != null ? String(row[1]) : '';
      }
    });
    return settings;
  });
}

/**
 * Returns a current user label suitable for logs.
 * @returns {string}
 */
function getCurrentUserLabel_() {
  try {
    const email = Session.getActiveUser().getEmail() || Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail();
    return email || 'system';
  } catch (error) {
    return 'system';
  }
}

/**
 * Removes unsafe characters and trims input text.
 * @param {*} value
 * @returns {string}
 */
function safeText_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f<>]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

/**
 * Normalizes a search query for comparisons.
 * @param {*} value
 * @returns {string}
 */
function normalizeText_(value) {
  return safeText_(value).toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * Converts a value to a Date when possible.
 * @param {*} value
 * @returns {Date|null}
 */
function toDate_(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }
  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]' && !isNaN(value.getTime())) {
    return new Date(value.getTime());
  }
  const parsed = new Date(value);
  return isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
}

/**
 * Converts a date-like value into an ISO date string.
 * @param {*} value
 * @returns {string}
 */
function toIsoDate_(value) {
  const date = toDate_(value);
  if (!date) {
    return '';
  }
  return Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
}

/**
 * Converts a date-like value into an ISO timestamp string.
 * @param {*} value
 * @returns {string}
 */
function toIsoDateTime_(value) {
  const date = toDate_(value);
  if (!date) {
    return '';
  }
  return Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss");
}

/**
 * Formats a date in Thai Buddhist calendar format.
 * @param {*} value
 * @returns {string}
 */
function formatThaiDate_(value) {
  const date = toDate_(value);
  if (!date) {
    return '-';
  }
  const thaiMonths = ['ม.ค.', 'ก.พ.', 'มี.ค.', 'เม.ย.', 'พ.ค.', 'มิ.ย.', 'ก.ค.', 'ส.ค.', 'ก.ย.', 'ต.ค.', 'พ.ย.', 'ธ.ค.'];
  const day = Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'd');
  const month = thaiMonths[Number(Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'M')) - 1];
  const year = Number(Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy')) + 543;
  return `${day} ${month} ${year}`;
}

/**
 * Formats a timestamp for audit display.
 * @param {*} value
 * @returns {string}
 */
function formatThaiDateTime_(value) {
  const date = toDate_(value);
  if (!date) {
    return '-';
  }
  const thaiMonths = ['ม.ค.', 'ก.พ.', 'มี.ค.', 'เม.ย.', 'พ.ค.', 'มิ.ย.', 'ก.ค.', 'ส.ค.', 'ก.ย.', 'ต.ค.', 'พ.ย.', 'ธ.ค.'];
  const day = Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'd');
  const month = thaiMonths[Number(Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'M')) - 1];
  const year = Number(Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy')) + 543;
  const time = Utilities.formatDate(date, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'HH:mm');
  return `${day} ${month} ${year} ${time}`;
}

/**
 * Returns the current date with the correct timezone.
 * @returns {Date}
 */
function todayInBangkok_() {
  const now = new Date();
  const dateString = Utilities.formatDate(now, APP_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  return new Date(`${dateString}T00:00:00`);
}

/**
 * Calculates the whole-day difference between two dates.
 * @param {Date} endDate
 * @param {Date} startDate
 * @returns {number}
 */
function daysBetween_(endDate, startDate) {
  const end = new Date(endDate.getFullYear(), endDate.getMonth(), endDate.getDate());
  const start = new Date(startDate.getFullYear(), startDate.getMonth(), startDate.getDate());
  return Math.round((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 86400000);
}

/**
 * Calculates a stock status based on remaining quantity and expiry.
 * @param {*} expireDateValue
 * @param {*} quantityValue
 * @returns {{label: string, daysLeft: number|null, key: string}}
 */
function calculateStockStatus_(expireDateValue, quantityValue) {
  const quantity = Number(quantityValue) || 0;
  if (quantity <= 0) {
    return { label: STATUS_LABELS.EMPTY, daysLeft: null, key: 'empty' };
  }
  const expireDate = toDate_(expireDateValue);
  if (!expireDate) {
    return { label: STATUS_LABELS.NORMAL, daysLeft: null, key: 'normal' };
  }
  const today = todayInBangkok_();
  const daysLeft = daysBetween_(expireDate, today);
  if (daysLeft < 0) {
    return { label: STATUS_LABELS.EXPIRED, daysLeft, key: 'expired' };
  }
  if (daysLeft === 0) {
    return { label: STATUS_LABELS.EXPIRED_TODAY, daysLeft, key: 'expiredToday' };
  }
  if (daysLeft === 1) {
    return { label: STATUS_LABELS.EXPIRING_1, daysLeft, key: 'expiring1' };
  }
  if (daysLeft === 2) {
    return { label: STATUS_LABELS.EXPIRING_2, daysLeft, key: 'expiring2' };
  }
  if (daysLeft === 3) {
    return { label: STATUS_LABELS.EXPIRING_3, daysLeft, key: 'expiring3' };
  }
  return { label: STATUS_LABELS.NORMAL, daysLeft, key: 'normal' };
}

/**
 * Returns the app shell assets for the frontend.
 * @returns {Object}
 */
function getAppBootstrapData_() {
  const settings = getSettingsMap_();
  return {
    app: getAppConfig_(),
    settings,
    masters: getMasterItems_(),
    dashboard: getDashboardMetrics_(),
    stockPage: getStockPage_({ page: 1, pageSize: 10, query: '', status: 'all', sortField: 'LastUpdate', sortDirection: 'desc' })
  };
}

/**
 * Serves dynamic app assets such as the manifest and service worker.
 * @param {string} asset
 * @returns {GoogleAppsScript.Content.TextOutput}
 */
function serveAsset_(asset) {
  if (asset === 'manifest') {
    return ContentService
      .createTextOutput(buildManifest_())
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }
  if (asset === 'sw' || asset === 'service-worker') {
    return ContentService
      .createTextOutput(buildServiceWorker_())
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JAVASCRIPT);
  }
  return ContentService.createTextOutput('');
}

/**
 * Builds the PWA manifest at runtime so it works inside GAS.
 * @returns {string}
 */
function buildManifest_() {
  const baseUrl = getWebAppUrl_() || '.';
  const manifest = {
    name: APP_CONFIG.title,
    short_name: APP_CONFIG.shortTitle,
    start_url: baseUrl,
    scope: baseUrl,
    display: 'standalone',
    orientation: 'portrait-primary',
    background_color: '#f8fafc',
    theme_color: '#0f766e',
    icons: [
      { src: APP_ICON_DATA_URL, sizes: '192x192', type: 'image/png' },
      { src: APP_ICON_DATA_URL, sizes: '512x512', type: 'image/png' }
    ]
  };
  return JSON.stringify(manifest);
}

/**
 * Builds the service worker script used for offline shell caching.
 * @returns {string}
 */
function buildServiceWorker_() {
  return `
const CACHE_NAME = 'sterile-stock-v1';
const APP_SHELL = self.location.origin + self.location.pathname;
const CORE_ASSETS = [
  APP_SHELL,
  APP_SHELL + '?asset=manifest'
];

self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.addAll(CORE_ASSETS)).then(() => self.skipWaiting())
  );
});

self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((keys) => Promise.all(keys.filter((key) => key !== CACHE_NAME).map((key) => caches.delete(key))))
      .then(() => self.clients.claim())
  );
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  if (event.request.method !== 'GET') {
    return;
  }
  const requestUrl = new URL(event.request.url);
  if (requestUrl.origin === self.location.origin && requestUrl.pathname === self.location.pathname) {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(event.request)
        .then((response) => {
          const clone = response.clone();
          caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.put(APP_SHELL, clone));
          return response;
        })
        .catch(() => caches.match(APP_SHELL).then((cached) => cached || caches.match(event.request)))
    );
    return;
  }
  event.respondWith(
    caches.match(event.request).then((cached) => cached || fetch(event.request))
  );
});
  `.trim();
}
